_about: Online play timing. Milliseconds unless the name says otherwise. Read by net/net.js (the connection) and practice.js (the live cue).
_aboutKeepalive: Each side sends a small 'still here' message this often while connected.
_aboutTimeout: Nothing heard from the other side for this long: the connection counts as lost.
_aboutFriendAlive: Host: a new player is told 'game is full' only if the friend was heard from within this time. A friend who reloaded the page goes quiet sooner, so they can come back.
_aboutHello: Host: a new connection that does not say hello within this time is closed.
_aboutConnect: Friend: one try to reach the host's PC is given up after this long.
_aboutJoinTries: Friend, first join only: give up after this many tries that found the game but could not connect. After the first success the friend keeps trying without end.
_aboutReconnect: Friend: the wait between tries to reach the host again.
_aboutServerRetry: The wait between tries to get back in touch with the join-code service after losing it.
_aboutNewCode: Host: a new random code that is already in use is swapped for another this many times before giving up.
_aboutCodeBusy: Host resuming a saved match: the service may still hold the old code for a while. Try again this often, and give up after this long.
_aboutAim: The shooter sends the cue (aim, power, hit point, cue angle, cue ball in hand) at most this many times a second.
_aboutAimResend: The cue is sent again at least this often even when it has not moved.
_aboutSmoothing: How quickly the other player's cue glides to the newest values (higher is quicker).
